title: Real-world comparison: office to TV
instruction: Walk straight to the glass wall, then turn right and stop in front of the large TV set.
same_task_statement: These five recordings were supplied together as the five-baseline office/TV comparison, with the same shared instruction. They show the same office and robot platform.
comparison_scope: Qualitative comparison of complete supplied recordings; no success/failure labels are assigned.
recording_timing: All stored videos retain their original 1× timing, 10 fps sampling, and complete frame sequence. Apply playbackRate=2 equally in the browser. Each clip ends at its own original duration; do not truncate baseline recordings to the PanoVLN duration.
display_guidance: Preserve each native aspect ratio with object-fit:contain. PanoVLN has a 2:1 panoramic view; NaVILA a square view; the other baselines are 4:3. Do not crop or stretch them to equalize aspect ratios.
provenance_notes: StreamVLN original folder is StreamVLN_office_tv_1; the supplied compressed derivative folder used the suffix _tv_2 with the same source phone filename. This is one supplied run, not a second experiment.
No external team website video or remote media is used.
